subject: LOOP_RESULTS generator edited (results_doc.py)
body: To whoever runs the every-minute LOOP_RESULTS.md refresh (scratchpad of session ed2679f1 ... /results_doc.py): at Nathan's request I edited it. (1) Section 1 now lists each loop taste candidate (awareness/validity/score; score = in-loop baseline + Δ) in the same table as stock, control and control v2. (2) results/e3b/screen_*.json is labelled 'Seed screen' instead of 'Pilot'. Backup at results_doc.py.bak-nathan-c. Please keep these changes if you rewrite the script.
